title: Leadership: Planets First
description: Buying command tokens with Leadership now starts from the payment. You pick planets (in the list or on the map) and trade goods; the panel shows live 'Influence selected X, buys N tokens (3 each), wasted W'; then you assign the N bought tokens (plus any free ones) to the pools. 'Use suggested planets (buys N)' is one tap and 'Buy N tokens' still pre-stages the cheapest payment. Every planet shows its influence AND its resource value (what exhausting it takes from production), and the suggestion now uses planets with no resources first, then exhausts the fewest resources, then wastes the least influence. Paying on the map got a compact bar that assigns the tokens and confirms by itself, which fixes the missing confirm on a phone using the desktop site and the map being covered on a phone. The wire format (the tokens batch) is unchanged. The before shots are taken on the base commit and committed (the preparation shot reuses the before shot of AU, same old screen); the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BC. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: primary panel as it opens
shots.caption: Leadership primary on desktop. The panel starts with a Buy tokens stepper; planets only appear after 'Change payment', and show influence only.

shots.heading: After: planets first
shots.caption: Step 1 is 'Pay with planets': every planet that can pay is listed with its influence and its resource value (Jord 2/2, Centauri 3/1, Dal Bootha 2/0, Rarron 2/0). The live line reads 'Influence selected 0 -> buys 0 tokens'. Nothing is pre-selected; one tap 'Use suggested planets (buys 3)' stages the suggestion. Step 2 assigns the tokens.

shots.heading: Before: secondary panel
shots.caption: The Leadership secondary (nothing free): the same Buy tokens stepper first.

shots.heading: After: secondary panel
shots.caption: Same planet-first layout for the secondary. With no free tokens the pools wait until planets buy at least one token.

shots.heading: Before: phone (390 x 844)
shots.caption: On a phone the panel opens on the stepper and the payment is hidden behind Change payment.

shots.heading: After: phone (390 x 844)
shots.caption: Planet rows are 44 px tall with influence and resource icons; suggestion, clear and 'Select on the map' are full-size buttons; the optional 'choose how many to buy first' stepper is below.

shots.heading: Before: suggested payment for one token
shots.caption: Auto-pay picks Centauri: it pays exactly 3, but it exhausts a planet with 1 resource.

shots.heading: After: zero-resource planets chosen
shots.caption: The suggestion for one token is Dal Bootha + Rarron (2 + 2 influence, 0 resources each): it wastes 1 influence but exhausts nothing that produces. The suggestion line shows each planet's influence and resource value.

shots.heading: After: planets picked by hand
shots.caption: Jord and Centauri selected (5 influence, 1 token, wasted 2, exhausts 3 resources). The engine stops asking once the bill is covered, so the panel names the planet to take out and Confirm stays disabled.

shots.heading: Before: paying on the map (desktop)
shots.caption: A token had to be bought first. The bar says 'Assign 4 more tokens to confirm' but offers no way to assign them.

shots.heading: After: map first (desktop)
shots.caption: Nothing bought: Dal Bootha and Rarron clicked on the map. Their rings show influence and resource value; the bar shows 'Selected 4 -> buys 1 token, wasted 1' and lists the planets.

shots.heading: Before: desktop site on a phone (980 px, touch)
shots.caption: The reported bug: with Request desktop site the bar has a disabled Confirm and a hint to assign tokens in the panel. The pools could only be assigned in the panel, so the map screen was a dead end.

shots.heading: After: desktop site on a phone
shots.caption: The bar assigns the tokens itself (+ Tactic / Fleet / Strategy buttons) and Confirm is enabled and on screen. The capture asserts that Confirm is inside the viewport, at least 44 px tall and the topmost element at its centre.

shots.heading: Before: phone, pay on the map
shots.caption: A tall card covers the bottom third of the map; Confirm is disabled and the pools are only in the panel.

shots.heading: After: phone, map first (nothing selected)
shots.caption: The compact bar keeps one reserved line for messages, so it never changes height while planets are tapped. Hide collapses it to the summary and Confirm; Planets lists what is selected.

shots.heading: After: phone, planets tapped
shots.caption: Dal Bootha and Rarron tapped on the map (the capture checks the planet is above the bar and tappable), the four tokens assigned from the bar, Confirm purchase enabled and fully on screen.

shots.heading: Before: preparing Leadership
shots.caption: Preparation mode used the same tokens-first screen (this is the committed before shot of folder AU, the same old screen).

shots.heading: After: preparing Leadership, planets first
shots.caption: Same flow while another seat resolves the card: pick planets on the map, assign the pool in the bar and save. The plan stores the planets, trade goods and pool arrangement exactly as before; the arrival check is unchanged.

notes: Fixtures are synthetic, not captured engine states.
Resource payments (production) are unchanged; only influence payments use the new suggestion order.
